art_instructions: Inside the cozy Greek classroom, show the same low honey‑oak student table from the previous page, with an open picture book still lying on it. Glaux the owl (mottled brown‑and‑cream feathers, round amber eyes, small green scarf at her neck) perches on the near edge of the table slightly right of center, body angled three‑quarters toward the viewer, looking pleased. One small, simple gray mouse (rounded shape, tiny ears, closed eyes, no gore) is gently held at her beak as she swallows; the second mouse rests on the tabletop by her right talon, ready to be eaten next. Keep the moment calm and tidy: no mess, no fear—just a content owl enjoying the mice. Two empty child‑sized chairs sit around the table; Glaux’s tiny satchel hangs from the back of the nearer chair with a couple of picture cards peeking out. The background shows soft blue walls (#ADD8E6), bright natural light from a large window on the left, and a colorful woven rug on the stone floor beneath the table. On the back wall, include a small chalkboard with the neat chalk words “μῦς” and “δύο μῦες” to reinforce the vocabulary. Maintain the classroom’s clean village‑school feel with simple wooden beams and warm yellow accents on the furniture.
